button.name: Discover
button.button_desc: The discovery process detects structural information related to entities in database systems and file systems.

button.name: Derive Relations
button.button_desc: The Derive Foreign Key Joins Wizard is used to determine the joins between entities in a model version when foreign keys are not defined in the database system.

button.name: Profile Data
button.button_desc: Profiling is the process of inspecting data and collecting information about the characteristics of the data contained by a source system.

button.name: Document Model
button.button_desc: Generate model and source system documentation, data validation documentation or documentation comparing source systems.

button.name: Compare Models
button.button_desc: Compare the structure, business rules or profiling metrics for multiple models.

button.name: Create Star Schema
button.button_desc: The Creating a Star Schema wizard enables you to create a star schema from source data.

button.name: Create EDW
button.button_desc: Launch the create an EDW wizard.

button.name: Create Data Vault Design
button.button_desc: The Create Data Vault Design wizard enables you to create a model from your source data to be used for generating a data vault.

button.name: Advanced Copy
button.button_desc: Copy a model with the ability to configure the following settings: - Set the copied versions to use the original source mappings. - Import hidden objects. - Apply model conversions.
